snippet.title: Sonic RPG Episode 10 - Director's Cut [OFFICIAL]
snippet.description:
Reminder; Play the game at: https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/775845

Here are all the scenes on the latest Sonic RPG Episode 10 in FullHD for your pleasure!
During assembly of the whole game we had to discard the Vector based animation, since Flash was not capable of handling all the assets on the library. This posed a big problem during the last days, so we opted to add the scenes on mid-res video.

All the awesome artists who took part on this project are as follows:
